checkedAlternates.risk: Powdered sugar is made from white sucrose.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Confectioners’ sugar is pulverized into a fine anti-caking dust (group-1), not free-flowing dry crystals (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Turbinado is amber-colored with trace molasses.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Turbinado consists of large dry washed crystals (group-4), unlike moist molasses-coated soft brown sugars (group-3).
